## [1.0.2](https://github.com/nikhilbadyal/nik-morphe-patches/compare/v1.0.1...v1.0.2) (2026-11-07)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **swiftbackup:** correct Wi-Fi backup discovery check ([86509b9](https://github.com/nikhilbadyal/nik-morphe-patches/commit/86509b9d077928390db4d453761f2977d6307134))

patches.name: Swift Backup Blacklist Limit
patches.description: Raises the shared blacklist limit from 100 to 1,000 apps.

patches.name: Swift Backup Cloud Apps Visibility
patches.description: Displays all backups present in the cloud tag without dropping blacklisted or system apps.

patches.name: Swift Backup Cloud Settings Backup
patches.description: Adds opt-in automatic cloud backup and explicit restore for settings, favorites, and the blacklist.

patches.name: Swift Backup Cloud WiFi Backups
patches.description: Detects and restores existing WiFi backups from cloud storage when metadata is missing from the local database.

patches.name: Swift Backup Local Cloud Metadata
patches.description: Makes cloud backups work by keeping their metadata on persistent local storage and syncing to the connected cloud.

patches.name: Swift Backup Settings Export and Import
patches.description: Shows Export settings and Import settings for signed-in users, including blacklist transfer.

patches.name: Swift Backup Tamper Protection
patches.description: Stops the app from closing itself on patched installs.

patches.name: Swift Backup Web Login
patches.description: Makes Google sign-in work for connecting cloud accounts.
